scope: Representative-patch T2 closure only; M2 defaults and T3 remain pending

protocol.scope: Offline saved-pose quadrature, seal threshold and capability screening
protocol.threshold_refinement_note: Initial 1000/2000-interval broad-gap scans under-resolved the smooth 0.1mm transition. Refine resolution; keep 1% limit.
protocol.geometry_note: Same nominal projected support geometry; CG height bounds include +/-2mm wall heights and 4mm normal joint travel. Lateral travel and noncoplanar contact effects remain native/T3 checks, not analytic guarantees.

threshold.scope: Algebraic gap sweep: residual-channel closure and gross seal lift; pressure/fan steady reference, no claim of dynamic hysteresis

capability_screen.scope: Capability screening at observed preload-moment extrema, CG height +8mm bound; not an exhaustive noncoplanar/lateral-travel guarantee

fault_budget.interpretation: Fault boundaries, not a universal fault-tolerance pass. Parallel fan heads do not add; stopped ports retain specified backflow.

protocol.scope: Pressure-core isolation, no change to tyre 1ms calibration and no claim of full mechanical 0.5ms convergence
